snippet.title: Wandering Sword | Secrets of the Eastern Sea | DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
The brand new DLC trailer, Secrets of the Eastern Sea is out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876890/Wandering_Sword/

A mysterious gamble draws you into a brand-new chapter of the martial world.

In Secrets of the Eastern Sea, you'll meet a divination girl, explore a forgotten island, uncover lost martial arts, and shape your destiny with every choice you make.

Between conflict and peace, what path will you take?

Join our communities:
